api.name: Message
api.title: Message
api.description: The body and the headers of the exchange, from exchange.getMessage(). getBody(type) converts the body with the type converters (a Map body has no properties: read map.get("type"), not ${body.type}); getHeader(name) is case-insensitive and null when the header is absent; setBody replaces the body and keeps the headers.

getBody.description: The body, converted to the type when one is given (String, byte[], InputStream, a POJO through the registered converters); null when there is no body or no conversion.

getExchange.description: The exchange this message belongs to (properties, variables, context).

signatures: <T> T getHeader(String name, Object defaultValue, Class<T> type)
<T> T getHeader(String name, Supplier<Object> defaultValueSupplier, Class<T> type)
getHeader.description: A header by name (case-insensitive), converted to the type; null when absent, or the default value when one is given.

getHeaders.description: All headers as a case-insensitive Map<String, Object>; changes to the map change the message.

getMandatoryBody.description: Like getBody(type) but throws InvalidPayloadException when the body is null or cannot be converted.

removeHeader.description: Removes a header; removeHeaders(pattern) removes by wildcard, e.g. "Camel*" strips the Camel ones.

setBody.description: Replaces the body, the headers stay; this is how a step returns its result.

setHeader.description: Sets a header; headers travel with the message to the endpoints (as HTTP headers, JMS properties, Kafka headers).
